question: Which fallacy is involved in the following statement "Indian pharmaceutical companies are profitable, therefore, average Indian pharmaceutical company is profitable"?
solution:
The Fallacy of Division occurs when one assumes 
that what
is true for the group as a whole must also be true for each part. 
In this case, just because Indian pharmaceutical companies as 
a whole are profitable does not necessarily mean that every 
individual pharmaceutical company in India is profitable.

solution:

question:
Passage (Q46-Q50): Science and the techniques to which it has given rise have changed human life during the last hundred and fifty years more than it had been changed since men took to agriculture, and the changes that are being wrought by science continue at an increasing speed. There is no sign of any new stability to be attained on some scientific plateau. On the contrary, there is every reason to think that the revolutionary possibilities of science extend immeasurably beyond what has so far been realised. Can the human race adjust itself quickly enough to these vertiginous transformations, or will it, as innumerable former species have done, perish from lack of adaptability? The dinosaurs were, in their day, the lords of creation, and if there had been philosophers among them, not one would have foreseen that the whole race might perish. But they became extinct because they could not adapt themselves to a world without swamps. In the case of man and science there is a wholly new factor, namely that man himself is creating the changes of environment to which he will have to adjust himself with unprecedented rapidity. But, although man through his scientific skill is the cause of the changes of environment, most of these changes are not willed by human beings. Although they come about through human agencies, they have, or at any rate have had so far, something of the inexorable inevitability of natural forces.
